input.summary: Add a reasonableness standard to the consent required for non-successor assignments under Section 18.9.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 18.9 already lets either Party assign to an acquirer of substantially all of its business or assets on a writing delivered to the other Party, but consent for any other assignment is at the other Party's absolute discretion. We have added the customary reasonableness qualifier, consistent with the standard already used for Affiliate assignments in the same Section.

ops.oldText: This Agreement may not be assigned by either Party to any Third Party without the written consent of the other Party hereto
ops.newText: This Agreement may not be assigned by either Party to any Third Party without the written consent of the other Party hereto (which shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed)
